classification.difficultyReason: Match sides using equal angles in the rotated triangles before multiplying by the scale factor; elsewhere distinguish original from image lengths to choose division or multiplication.

spec.description: Original circle left and enlarged image right, with centres and corresponding radius segments.
spec.mathematics: Original radius 5 cm; scale factor 2; image radius unknown.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied 10 cm answer is omitted from the question diagram and retained in the answer.

spec.description: Two upright triangles in a paired row, retaining all side and angle givens. Ordinary outlines use black.
spec.mathematics: Both triangles have apex 70°, bottom-left 50° and bottom-right 60°. Original sides 8, 7 and 8.7; image left side 24 and base 26.1; image right side unknown.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied answer 21 is retained only in the answer.

spec.description: Paired upright house-shaped pentagons, with corresponding roof slopes, vertical sides, bases and right-angle markers. Diagram proportions are schematic.
spec.mathematics: Each pentagon has apex 74°, shoulder angles 143° and two bottom right angles. Original vertical sides 2; image roof sides 6, vertical sides 3 and base 8. Find the original roof sides and base.
spec.answerVisibility: Original unknown lengths remain unlabelled; supplied answers appear only in the answer.

answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Original left roof side}&=6\div1.5\\&=4\\\text{Original right roof side}&=6\div1.5\\&=4\\\text{Original base}&=8\div1.5\\&=\dfrac{16}{3}=5.\overline{3}\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Original triangle left and rotated image right. Angle positions establish correspondence; the image's supplied 8 cm side lies above its two unknown sides.
spec.mathematics: Original angles 78° at bottom left, 41° at bottom right, 61° above; sides 3.8 cm between 78° and 61°, 5.6 cm between 41° and 61°, and 5 cm between 78° and 41°. Image angles 41° upper left, 78° upper right, 61° below; upper side 8 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Both unknown image lengths remain unlabelled; supplied answers appear only in the answer.

answer.short: Between $41^\circ$ and $61^\circ$: $8.96\text{ cm}$; between $78^\circ$ and $61^\circ$: $6.08\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Match corresponding sides using the equal angles.
$\begin{aligned}\text{Image side between }41^\circ\text{ and }61^\circ&=5.6\times1.6\\&=8.96\text{ cm}\\\text{Image side between }78^\circ\text{ and }61^\circ&=3.8\times1.6\\&=6.08\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$
